title: The Wave That Divided Blood
intro: Picture a vast flood rising over the land, an Ark floating steady, and one soul left outside by choice. Bound by blood to a prophet yet separated by belief, this figure faced a final call to come aboard as the waters surged. Can you uncover the identity behind the refusal?
clues: I am the offspring of one of the greatest prophets of Allah, a household of faith I chose to leave.
I lived in the time of the Great Flood, when disbelief covered the land like water.
I refused to board the Ark with the believers when my father called out to me.
I said I would seek refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water.
I was told that nothing could protect from the decree of Allah on that Day except mercy.
I was overtaken by the waves and drowned, and my father was told I was not of his righteous family.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Zayd ibn Harithah
Prophet Ishaq, Son of Prophet Ibrahim
The Disbelieving Son of Prophet Nuh
Habil, Son of Prophet Adam
Prophet Ismail, Son of Prophet Ibrahim
identity.answer: The Disbelieving Son of Prophet Nuh

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Being sold into slavery in Egypt after betrayal by brothers
Refusing to board the Ark and seeking a mountain as refuge
Being thrown into a blazing fire for breaking idols
Being swallowed by a great fish after fleeing a mission
Sleeping for centuries in a cave to escape persecution
trial.answer: Refusing to board the Ark and seeking a mountain as refuge

location.label: Key Element
options: The mirrored palace of glass in Saba
The wooden chest cast into the river
The towering mountain sought as refuge from the Flood
The burning bush in the sacred valley
The Kaaba built as a house of worship
location.answer: The towering mountain sought as refuge from the Flood

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Swallowed by the earth with treasures for arrogance
Granted a kingdom with power over winds and jinn
Made cool and safe as fire became peace
Raised alive to the heavens and saved from crucifixion
Drowned in the Flood and declared not of the righteous family
outcome.answer: Drowned in the Flood and declared not of the righteous family

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
